description: Three stereo send and return loops around a stereo path, each with level controls and CV

params.text: Chooses whether that send is taken before the dry level knob or after it
Sets how much signal goes to that send pair, 0 to 100%
Sets how much of that return pair is added to the output, 0 to 100%
Sets the level of the dry signal in the output, 0 to 100%

inputs.text: Shifts that send level, a fifth of the knob's travel per volt
Shifts that return level, a fifth of the knob's travel per volt
Left channel coming back from that loop; nothing from the loop reaches the output until this jack is patched
Right channel coming back from that loop; with it empty the left return of the same loop is used for both
Left audio into the module, and the signal used for both channels when the right jack is empty
Shifts the dry level, a fifth of the knob's travel per volt, clamped to ±5V before it is added

outputs.text: Left channel of that send, at the level its own knob sets
Right channel of that send, at the level its own knob sets
Left output: the dry signal at its set level plus every patched return, clamped to ±10V
Right output: the dry signal at its set level plus every patched return, clamped to ±10V

notes: a send pair is only calculated while one of its two output jacks is patched, and a return is only read while its left jack is patched.
a lamp beside each send and each return follows the level passing through it, refreshed every 256 samples.
